headline: Afreximbank targets $1 billion in deals at Creative Africa Nexus event
summary: Afreximbank is aiming to facilitate up to $1 billion in business deals during the 2026 Creative Africa Nexus (CANEX WKND) in Lagos. The initiative seeks to boost investment in Africa's creative industries.
why: Afreximbank is a key multilateral financial institution focused on promoting intra-African trade and economic development across the continent.
